entries.note: Yamashita-Kashima 2011 (PMID 21700765) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract. No tumour PD readout in JOSHUA/JACOB abstracts; untested on the N87 track holds.

Nordstrom 2011 (PMC3326565) quote verbatim; FDA 761150 review confirms N87 ADCC target (model_filed). The CD16A genotype-by-response analysis (ASCO 2018 abstr 4030) is an efficacy comparison, not a PD readout; untested holds.

Wei 2017 (PMC5584228) quote verbatim in abstract. PubMed has no dedicated KN026 preclinical paper (0 hits for KN026 AND xenograft/preclinical), so the CRIB-platform paper is the best available model source; low confidence is right.
Quote verbatim. Perjeta EPAR (pdftotext) confirms the 20 ug/mL target and names no gastric model or N87; untested opening on the gastric xenograft track is correct.
Nordstrom 2011 quote verbatim (the abstract sentence is longer, fragment is exact). Monkey margin stated, no human target: untested opening with margin_stated is consistent with decision 16.

Catenacci 2020 'acceptable safety and tolerability; no dose-limiting toxicities in the dose-escalation phase' verbatim. ASCO 2018 abstract 4030 resolves (2018-05-20; title only): year 2018. Decision 16 margin held; combination_with pembrolizumab right.

Wei 2017 quote verbatim in full text (PMC5584228). No model-stated exposure target; RP2D came from breast clinical exposure-response (Zhang 2022, PMID 34844975 resolves). Untested is right and is the logic dose #2 should also follow.
Quote verbatim in the Clin Cancer Res abstract. Opening untested on the N87/4-1ST track at first pertuzumab use in a gastric model.

Tabernero 2018 (PMID 30217672) conclusion verbatim in abstract; primary OS HR 0.84, p=0.057 missed. ESMO 2017 abstract resolves (Crossref doi 10.1093/annonc/mdx369, Ann Oncol Sept 2017, 'Final analysis... JACOB'; title only): year 2017. Combination and design in note; drug/route/population right.

Nordstrom 2011 quote verbatim; hCD16A-158F transgenic mouse plus genotyped-donor ADCC is one system, patient-level prediction correctly recorded. FDA 761150 caveat on mouse Fc receptors confirmed at the cited text.

Catenacci 2020 (PMID 32653053) '17 (18.48%...) of 92' verbatim in abstract. ASCO 2018 abstract 4030 resolves (Crossref 2018-05-20, title only): year 2018. Single-arm combination on primary ORR in predicted direction: same, partial. Retrodiction vs ToGA stays a rule question.
Wei 2017 quote verbatim in full text. Separate CRIB biparatopic track is justified: different molecule and different prediction from the pertuzumab-plus-trastuzumab xenografts.

Xu 2023 (PMID 36370604) HER2-high ORR 56% verbatim. ASCO 2021 e16005 resolves (Crossref 2021-05-20, title 'preliminary efficacy of KN026... gastric'; text not read): year 2021. Monotherapy single-arm, same; drug/route/population right.

Liu 2026 (PMID 41571045) conclusion verbatim; both co-primaries met, design in note. NCT05427383 is phase II/III; its phase II part (Cancer Commun, doi 10.1002/cac2.70080) epub 2025-11-22, so 2025 holds; ESMO 2025 LBA not independently located.

EPAR (EMA/17250/2013, dated 13 Dec 2012) downloads and the quote is verbatim at the non-clinical discussion; comparison_stated and imported_from breast are right. The CHMP report became public with the March 2013 EU decision, so year 2013, print_year 2013.
entries.adjudication_note: Status same agreed. Rule 6: the Perjeta EPAR (EMA/17250/2013) became public with the March 2013 EU decision; the December 2012 CHMP date is internal. Year 2013, print_year 2013.

entries.note: Tabernero 2018 AE sentence verbatim (diarrhoea 51 [13%] vs 25 [6%]); monkey-predicted diarrhoea held in gastric patients measured. Year 2017 from ESMO 2017 abstract mdx369 (resolves; title only). Drug, route, combination right.
Nordstrom 2011 quote verbatim; FDA 761150 review line 'No target organs for margetuximab were identified in monkeys' confirmed in the bundle. Untested opening on the monkey track.

Catenacci 2020 grade 3-4 AE sentence verbatim in abstract; ASCO 2018 abstract 4030 resolves (2018-05-20; title only), so year 2018. Gastric patients measured, nothing imported; infusion-reaction reasoning stands; combination_with pembrolizumab.

FDA 125409 ClinPharm review (curl+pdftotext) quote verbatim; it names no gastric model; bundle 761170 cites Malik 2003 xenografts as the target's origin. Track belongs under decision 8 (dose #2 adjudication routed the contra here); model_kind should read cross_indication, not animal.

Kang 2014 (PMID 24960402, epub 2014-06-24, Crossref) day-43 Cmin 40.0 and 62.7 ug/mL verbatim, above the 20 ug/mL xenograft target from the 2012 FDA review: target reached, same. Year 2014 is the earliest public date; failure stays in efficacy.

Ughetto 2021 (PMID 33755862, epub 2021-03-23) resolves; conclusion quote verbatim in abstract and full text. No pertuzumab gastric trial selected by copy number (JACOB IHC/ISH; NCI-MATCH J excludes gastric): patient-level untested opener stands. Full text: dual-blockade xenotrials ran in 5 hyper-amplified PDXs plus the two GTR0402 models.

entries.rule: 4 (contra requires the model's own prediction to have failed; #35/#72 attribution to untested conditions; #90 unresolved is untested) against 10
entries.note: Retrodiction flag right: Discussion opens on JACOB's 'formally negative results'. But the model's prediction was conditional on >=8 copies and the source attributes JACOB's miss to IHC/ISH selection it never modelled; source_calls_it unresolved maps to untested under #90. Note overstates: pertuzumab-arm CR <=3/8 (GTR0108/0233/0277), GTR0402 PR; 5/8 pools lapatinib. 'Apparently discordant' sentence unverified (Discussion truncated in scrape).
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4 Also-clause (#35/#72, #90): the PDX predicted only for >=8-copy tumours; JACOB's IHC/ISH population was never modelled, the source attributes the miss to that selection, and unresolved maps to untested. Decision 10's contra presumes a reproduction attempt.

missing: HER2 'hyper'-amplified (>=8 copies) gastric patient-derived xenografts run as 'preclinical randomized trials' with trastuzumab plus pertuzumab after JACOB had failed: Ughetto et al., Gastric Cancer 2021, doi 10.1007/s10120-021-01165-w (PMID 33755862) - dual blockade gave complete durable responses in 5/8 models and the authors set this against the negative trials. A retrodiction track for pertuzumab (retrodiction: true, contra at class level since it did not reproduce JACOB) carrying an untested patient-level prediction (HER2-hyper-amplified subgroup).

CD16A-genotype x response analysis in the gastric margetuximab trial: Catenacci et al., ASCO 2018 abstract 4030 (doi 10.1200/JCO.2018.36.15_suppl.4030), carried forward in Catenacci 2020 Lancet Oncol - the comparison the fc-optimised-adcc-cd16a-158f track's patient-level prediction needed (scored above as efficacy #4 corrected).

Earlier public records of KC-WISE on the CRIB track: ESMO Congress 2025 LBA oral (17 Oct 2025, Alphamab press release, PR Newswire) and the phase II part Zhao et al., Cancer Commun 2025, doi 10.1002/cac2.70080 (PMID 41273757) - change no status, move the year to 2025.
JACOB primary result first public at ESMO 2017 (abstract 616O; ASCO Post 2017-11-25) - changes no status, moves the 2018 JACOB entries to 2017 if congress abstracts count for dating.
rule_questions: Dating (rule 6): do congress abstracts published in journal supplements with a DOI (ESMO 2017 JACOB, ASCO 2018 CP-MGAH22-05, ESMO 2025 KC-WISE LBA) or sponsor press releases set `year`, or only registry posting, online journal publication, label and print? Three entries here move by a year on the answer.

Dose track attribution: when the programme's exposure target (pertuzumab 20 ug/mL trough) was stated by a different model system (breast xenografts) than the efficacy model on the track (N87 gastric xenograft), does 'reached, failed, abandoned' put contra on a separate track for the model that stated the target, or stay untested on the efficacy model's track (the draft's own treatment of KN026)?

Patient-level predictions in single-arm combination trials: is an exploratory genotype-by-response tabulation (5 responders, margetuximab plus pembrolizumab, no wild-type-Fc comparator) an admissible comparison for `same` when the model's claim was a differential (158F carriers gain most), or does it need a comparator arm?

A retrodiction model (Ughetto 2021 PDX) that contradicts the class-level patient result while proposing an untested patient-level selection rule: one track with a class-level contra entry plus a patient-level untested entry, or two prediction levels on one entry?

Member list: zanidatamab, a biparatopic anti-ERBB2 antibody with a phase 3 in HER2-positive GEA (HERIZON-GEA-01, NCT05152147; reported 2025), is absent from the tile's members while the biparatopic anbenitamab is included - intended split by modality group?

Retrodiction scope: trastuzumab (non-member, same target and action) succeeded in HER2-positive gastric cancer in ToGA (2009-2010) before the fc-optimised (2011) and CRIB (2017) models were public. Read literally, the efficacy rule makes their same entries (efficacy 4, 6, 7, 10) retro; does a non-member result in another line or regimen count?
